title: Toy Story 5 Opens Worldwide; Pollstar Confirms Bad Bunny First Latin Artist Past $1B Career Touring Gross
detail: Pixar's Toy Story 5 opens in theaters worldwide (June 19, 2026) with Bad Bunny voicing 'Pizza with Sunglasses' — an 'effortlessly cool and mysterious' forgotten toy — in both English and Spanish-language versions, alongside Tom Hanks, Tim Allen, Joan Cusack, Greta Lee, Keanu Reeves, Craig Robinson, Alan Cumming, and Conan O'Brien. The same week, a Pollstar report (dated June 19) confirms Bad Bunny crossed $1,008,918,203 in career touring gross on May 22, 2026 at a Barcelona concert — reaching $1 billion in 3,136 days since his first recorded show (October 20, 2017), the fastest of any artist this century, ahead of U2 (3,539 days), Ed Sheeran (3,755), Madonna (4,142), and The Rolling Stones (4,670). He becomes the first Latin artist to cross the $1 billion touring threshold. The Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour ranks No. 1 on Pollstar's Top 100 Worldwide Touring Artists chart, having sold 1,496,735 tickets to date.
